A conflict of interest occurs when an entity or individual becomes unreliable because of a clash between personal (or self-serving) interests and professional duties or responsibilities. Such a conflict occurs when a company or person has a vested interest such as money, status, knowledge, relationships, or reputation which puts into question whether their actions, judgment, and/or decision-making can be unbiased. When such a situation arises, the party is usually asked to remove themselves, and it is often legally required of them.

candidates.statement: 3.5.1 The Back-up QPPV shall be a licensed Liberian Pharmacist with a minimal qualification of Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy recognized by the Authority appropriate for his/her roles.

candidates.statement: 3.7 Responsibilities of QPPV The QPPV shall not be freelance, but an employee of the MAH or the Local Agent of the MAH. The responsibilities of the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance shall include but not limited to the following:
candidates.context: 3.6.2.3 Participation in at least one pharmacovigilance conference OR training program relevant to patient safety OR passing a written exam related to the QPPV roles administered by the Liberia Medicines and Health Products Regulatory Authority. 3.7.1 Act as a single point of contact for the Authority on all matters relating to pharmacovigilance and safety of marketed products including pharmacovigilance inspections.
